examples.explanation: The five small blocks tile the square from (1,1) to (4,4) without overlap.
A hole sits where [2,1,3,4] would go, so the union is not solid.
The last two blocks overlap on [2,2,3,3].

hints: Add up all small areas and compare with the area of the min/max bounding box.
Toggle each block corner in a set; interior corners appear an even number of times and cancel.
At the end exactly the four extreme corners must remain.
title: 467. Perfect Rectangle
